narratives.Overview:
- First ship is a closed `node --test` argv grammar inside `evaluateCommandSafety`. Add `node` to the static first-token list and route it through that grammar, same as python. Fall-through `{ ok: true, reason: null }` for `node` is forbidden. Do not ship a register-test-runner recipe. Do not wrap the filed command as `npm test` / `pnpm test`.
- After `node`, `tokens[0]` is exactly `--test`. Every later token that starts with `-` must start with `--test-` or `--experimental-test-`. Refuse `--test-reporter-destination` and `--test-rerun-failures` including `=value`. `--test-reporter` / `--test-reporter=` values are a closed allow-set of exact built-in names (`spec`, `tap`, `junit`, `lcov`, `dot`) matched as a whole string, either the token after `--test-reporter` or the suffix after `--test-reporter=`. Other `--test-reporter` tokens refuse, including missing values, `data:`, path-like, package-name, percent-encoded URLs, and the live space form `--test-reporter data:…`. Non-dash positionals pass. Coverage flags only after `--test`. Keep `-r` / `-e` / `-p` on the negative list. Do not copy `tool-events/classify.ts` `some(--test)`.
- Negative cases: `--import=`, `--require=`, `--experimental-loader=`, `--loader=`, `--inspect=`, `--inspect-port=`, `--eval=`, `--test-reporter-destination=`, `--test-rerun-failures=`, `--test-reporter=data:`, `--test-reporter=./file`, space forms of `--import` / `--require` / `--watch` / `--inspect-brk`, plus `-r` / `-e` / `-p`, plus `--test-reporter data:` and `--test-reporter ./file` as tests of the allow-set.
- Persist recovery: at `readStoredLiteralAcceptanceDetailed` copy or evaluate merge, recheck each stored `literal_acceptance_rejected` row with current `evaluateCommandSafety`. Drop only rows whose command now returns ok. Leave other rejected rows. Do not clear the whole ledger.
- Refusal reason for an unknown first token enumerates the accepted first tokens. The `safety-rejected` remedy names `npm test` / `pnpm test` as the known-safe wrap of a different recorded command.
- Scope sentence: this remainder changes the first-token grammar only. It does not change which fields are AC oracles. Flip the `safety-branches.test.ts` pins that refuse `node --test`. `run.ts` `shell: true` / `env: process.env` stays the #4702 residual.

## Gate stamp

Round-1 ceiling is this write-back (spend N=1). Single grok critic.

P1 is leftover(#4751) as filed: a closed `node --test` argv grammar in `evaluateCommandSafety`. Parent Dual-stop remaining 0; finish not still possible. Recut 5800470603 absorbed exact built-in reporter names. This number holds that remainder.

Re-measured at dispatch SHA `4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0` by pin-read.

Pin-read:

- `packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/safety.ts` `ALLOWED_FIRST_TOKENS` is `task`, `deft`, `directive`, `pnpm`, `npm`, `npx`, `yarn`, `bun`, `vitest`, plus `python`/`python3`/`py`. Comment at the set: bare pytest, uv, go test, and node --test stay out.
- Same function: unknown first token returns `first token ${JSON.stringify(first)} is not in the literal-AC allowlist` before any argv grammar. `node --test` never reaches a Node branch.
- Python interpreters have `evaluatePythonPytestArgs` (exact `-m pytest`). There is no Node `--test` grammar at this SHA.
- `packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/safety-branches.test.ts` pins `node --test` as allowlist refuse.

What this P1 is not:

- Not adding bare `node` to the first-token allowlist.
- Not a register-test-runner recipe.
- Not wrapping the filed command as `npm test` / `pnpm test`.
- Not FiScope `npm run lint` / `npm run build` / `task deft:check` (comment 5737701588).
- Not changing which fields are AC oracles.
- Not `run.ts` `shell: true` / `env: process.env` (#4702 residual).

Open forks the critic may take: bind the closed `node --test` grammar as filed (exact `--test`, `--test-` / `--experimental-test-` later dash tokens, exact built-in reporter names, persist-recovery of stored `literal_acceptance_rejected` rows); refuse a wider Node interpreter surface; keep first-token refuse and treat `npm test` as the only wrap.

Round 1, fresh critic, open critique. Input ceiling 5802197814. Tree reads pinned to `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:<path>`. Checks ran on that SHA (dest HEAD equals dispatch-sha) under Node v24.20.0.

## Anchors re-verified by execution

`pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/safety-branches.test.ts`: 35 passed. The three `node --test` pins still refuse with `/allowlist/`.

`pnpm exec tsx` import of `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/safety.ts` `evaluateCommandSafety`:

| command | ok | reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node --test` | false | `first token "node" is not in the literal-AC allowlist` |
| `node --test tests/display.test.js` | false | same first-token reason |
| `node -e 1` / `node script.js` | false | same first-token reason |
| `npm test` / `pnpm test` / `python -m pytest` / `vitest run` | true | `reason: null` |
| `go test` / `curl https://example.com` | false | first-token allowlist |
| `python -m pytest --foo` | true | python rest is open after exact `-m pytest` |
| `node --test --test-name-pattern=a\|b` | false | shell metacharacter `"\|"` |

Unknown-first-token reasons name the refused token only. They do not enumerate `ALLOWED_FIRST_TOKENS`. After the python branch, `evaluateCommandSafety` returns `{ ok: true, reason: null }`. Every token in the set at this SHA has a dedicated branch, so that return is dead for allowlisted bins today. Adding `node` to the set without a grammar would hit it.

`git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/capture.ts` `CLI_START_RE` already includes `node`, so a stated `node --test` is captured as shell-shaped and `pushCommand` records it on `literal_acceptance_rejected`.

Live Node v24.20.0, argv spawn, one-test `a.test.cjs` in `/tmp/4978-node-test`:

| invocation | observed |
| --- | --- |
| `--test-reporter=spec` and `--test-reporter spec` | exit 0 |
| `--test-reporter=dot` | exit 0, stdout `.` |
| `--test-reporter=data:text/javascript,console.log%281%29` | stdout `1`, then TypeError, exit 7 |
| `--test-reporter data:text/javascript,console.log%281%29` | stdout `1`, then TypeError, exit 7 |
| `--test-reporter=./reporter.cjs` and `--test-reporter ./reporter.cjs` | stdout `CUSTOM_REPORTER_RAN`, exit 7 |
| `--test-global-setup=./setup.cjs` and `--test-global-setup ./setup.cjs` | stdout `GLOBAL_SETUP_RAN`, exit 0 |

`node --help` on this runtime also lists `--test-global-setup=...`, `--test-randomize`, `--test-random-seed=...`, `--test-coverage-*`, `--experimental-test-tag-filter=...`. Those dash tokens start with `--test-` or `--experimental-test-`.

## Findings

### Reporter names are a closed allow-set on both attachments — sharpens-framing

**Evidence.** Bound remainder (issue body after recut 5800470603, Stop 1 5802197814) already says `--test-reporter` / `--test-reporter=` values are exact built-in names (`spec`, `tap`, `junit`, `lcov`, `dot`) via in-tree exact-token match. The negative-case list names `--test-reporter=data:` and `--test-reporter=./file`, and names space forms of `--import` / `--require` / `--watch` / `--inspect-brk`. Live Node on this host evaluates the space form `--test-reporter data:text/javascript,console.log%281%29` (stdout `1`) and loads `--test-reporter ./reporter.cjs`.

`git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/safety.ts` `evaluatePythonPytestArgs` matches `tokens[0] === "-m"` and `tokens[1] === "pytest"`, then returns `{ ok: true, reason: null }` for the rest. That is two whitespace tokens and no `=` split. Applying that analog to `--test-reporter` checks the next token for `spec` and leaves `--test-reporter=data:text/javascript,…` as one dash token that starts with `--test-`. Prefix-allow then admits the parent pain-audit 5800442997 shape. A denylist that exact-matches the listed stub `--test-reporter=data:` leaves the longer percent-encoded URL and the space form.

**Failure mode.** Tests copied from the negative-case list pin the `=` stubs. `node --test tests/display.test.js` goes green. Promoted `swarm.verify_commands` can still evaluate JavaScript through `--test-reporter data:…` or `--test-reporter=data:text/javascript,console.log%28process.env.HOME%29`, with `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/run.ts` `shell: true` / `env: process.env` as the standing #4702 residual.

**Disposition consequence.** The remainder can bind. State the reporter bullet as a closed allow-set of those five names, matched as a whole string, either as the token after `--test-reporter` or as the suffix after `--test-reporter=`. Other `--test-reporter` tokens refuse, including missing values. Keep the listed `=` strings and add the live space-form fixtures as tests of that allow-set. `evaluatePythonPytestArgs` is the space-form analog only.

### Persist recovery already has a read/merge site — sharpens-framing

**Evidence.** `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/capture.ts` `readStoredLiteralAcceptanceDetailed` copies `metadata.literal_acceptance_rejected` through `recordRejected` with the stored reason. It does not call `evaluateCommandSafety` on those rows. `mergeRejected` unions by `command\0reason`. `attachLiteralAcceptanceCommands` writes that union back whenever it attaches. `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/evaluate.ts` `evaluateLiteralAcceptanceFromPlan` sets `ok = false` when any merged rejected row remains.

Live on this SHA: a plan whose rejected ledger holds `{ command: "npm test", reason: "first token \"node\" is not in the literal-AC allowlist" }` fails the gate while `evaluateCommandSafety("npm test")` returns `{ ok: true, reason: null }`. The same copy path keeps a stored `node --test` first-token refuse after a new grammar would accept that string. `CLI_START_RE` already treats `node` as a capture start, so that row is the filed-command path.

**Failure mode.** Shipping the grammar and flipping `safety-branches.test.ts` leaves consumers who already captured `node --test` blocked on the old first-token reason. `task deft:check` stays red for the command this remainder admits.

**Disposition consequence.** The remainder can bind. Recheck each persisted rejected row with current `evaluateCommandSafety` at the `readStoredLiteralAcceptanceDetailed` copy loop, or at the evaluate merge. Drop only rows whose command now returns ok. Leave other rejected rows. Reuse `literal_acceptance_rejected` and `evaluateCommandSafety`.

## Footnotes

- `--test-global-setup` runs a file (live `GLOBAL_SETUP_RAN`). Prefix `--test-` admits it. Same trust class as non-dash positional test files Bound already allows, and as `python -m pytest <paths>`. Path-like `--test-reporter` values stay on the refuse list because that is the `data:` / package-resolve class from 5800442997.
- `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/acceptance-resolver.ts` `REMEDY["safety-rejected"]` is still `promote a safe alternative into plan.metadata.swarm.verify_commands or remove the stated command from the task statement (#3267)`. Bound already asks that string to name `npm test` / `pnpm test` as the known-safe wrap of a different recorded command. Existing slot; no new predicate.
- `node.exe --test` still fails as an unknown first token (`node.exe`). Remainder first token is `node`.
- `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/tool-events/classify.ts` still uses `rest.some((t) => normalizeToken(t) === "--test")`. Bound already keeps that as a verify bucket. Safety `tokens[0]` exactly `--test` is the execution grammar.

## Injection / swarm lens

This remainder changes which promoted `swarm.verify_commands` strings may spawn. Those strings can come from issue text after promote. Control is the closed `node --test` argv grammar (exact `--test`, dash-token prefix, destination and rerun-failures refuse, closed reporter-name allow-set on both attachments) plus the existing metachar scan in `safety.ts`. The metachar scan does not decode `data:` percent-encoding. `run.ts` `shell: true` / `env: process.env` stays the #4702 residual Bound already keeps.

## Road not taken

I considered classifying the space-form reporter row as `blocks-the-design` because live eval still works and the negative-case list omits it. Strongest case: a builder who copies the listed stubs and the python two-token analog re-admits `--test-reporter=data:…`, which is the parent blocking hole. What flips me to sharpening: Bound already names `--test-reporter` / `--test-reporter=` values as those five exact names. A closed allow-set on both attachments is a statement of that bullet. What would flip me to blocking: treating the negative-case list as the complete reporter rule.

I considered keeping first-token refuse and naming `npm test` as the wrap. Strongest case: `evaluateCommandSafety("npm test")` is already `{ ok: true, reason: null }` on this SHA, and the spawn surface does not grow. What flips me off: Stop 1 P1 is the original `node --test` string; Bound already records that wrap as a different command; this leftover exists because that wrap leaves the filed string red.

## Verdict

Bind the closed `node --test` grammar as filed, including exact built-in reporter names and persist recheck of stored `literal_acceptance_rejected` rows. Take the two sharpenings: reporter names as a closed five-name allow-set on both attachments, and persist recheck at the existing capture read/merge. Bare first-token `node` and a register-test-runner recipe stay out of this remainder.

| `--test-reporter=html` | `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` package `html` |
| `--test-global-setup=data:…` and the space form | `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` under cwd as a file path; no `DATA_EVAL` |
| `--test-global-setup=./setup.cjs`, space form, and absolute `/tmp/…/setup.cjs` | stdout `GLOBAL_SETUP_RAN`, exit 0 |
| `--test-global-setup=tap` / `file:` URL | cwd file-path miss, not package resolve |

`git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/capture.ts` `CLI_START_RE` already includes `node`, so a stated `node --test` is captured as shell-shaped and `pushCommand` records it on `literal_acceptance_rejected`.

Bound on 5802409842 admits `node --test` and `node --test <paths>` through a dedicated grammar (exact `--test`, later dash tokens limited to `--test-` / `--experimental-test-`, closed five-name reporter allow-set on both attachments including missing values, destination and rerun-failures refuse), and rechecks stored rejected rows with current `evaluateCommandSafety`, dropping only rows whose command now returns ok. That is the filed P1 string plus the persist half that currently fail-closes `verify:ac` / `task deft:check`.

## Findings

### `--test-global-setup` is a cwd file path — footnote

Live `--test-global-setup=data:…` does not evaluate JavaScript. Node looks for a file under cwd. Relative and absolute paths run `GLOBAL_SETUP_RAN`. That is the same path-load class Bound already allows for non-dash positional test files and that `python -m pytest <paths>` already allows. Reporter `data:` stays the eval class; Bound's closed five-name allow-set covers it.

### Bare `--test-reporter` package-resolves the next positional — footnote

Live `node --test --test-reporter a.test.cjs` looks up package `a.test.cjs`. Bound already refuses other `--test-reporter` tokens including missing values. That refuse is load-bearing for the closed grammar.

### `node.exe --test` stays an unknown first token — footnote

First token is `node.exe`. Bound first token is `node`.

## Injection / swarm lens

This remainder changes which promoted `swarm.verify_commands` strings may spawn. Those strings can come from issue text after promote. Control is the closed `node --test` argv grammar (exact `--test`, dash-token prefix, destination and rerun-failures refuse, closed reporter-name allow-set on both attachments including missing values) plus persist recheck of stored `literal_acceptance_rejected` rows plus the existing metachar scan in `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/safety.ts`. The metachar scan does not decode `data:` percent-encoding. Reporter allow-set is the control for that shape. `git show 4e6f0fed0c04a3f00573d39b7d3a5396da8a13d0:packages/core/src/literal-acceptance/run.ts` `shell: true` / `env: process.env` stays the #4702 residual Bound already keeps.

## Road not taken

I considered classifying persist "copy or evaluate merge" as `blocks-the-design` because `readStoredLiteralAcceptanceDetailed` copies stored reasons and `attachLiteralAcceptanceCommands` unions them back. Strongest case: evaluate-merge-only recheck leaves the xBRIEF row in place for a later attach. What flips me to footnote: the measured P1 path is `evaluateLiteralAcceptanceFromPlan` inside `verify:ac` / first check-graph gate; Bound's evaluate-merge site covers that gate. The copy site also stops attach from re-unioning a now-ok row. Either site unblocks the named pain.

I considered classifying `--test-global-setup` prefix-allow as `blocks-the-design` because it runs JavaScript. Strongest case: it looks like the parent reporter `data:` hole on another `--test-` flag. What flips me: live `data:` on global-setup is a cwd path miss; reporter `data:` prints `DATA_EVAL`. What would flip me to blocking: a runtime where `--test-global-setup` loads `data:` or package names the way `--test-reporter` does.

## Verdict

Bound remedy on successor lean 5802409842 covers Stop 1 `P1`. The first-token refuse of `node --test` is the named pain; the dedicated grammar admits that string; persist recheck drops the stored first-token row that still fail-closes the gate today. Census is footnote-only. Harvested Bound-remedy stays as written.

metadata.issueBody:
## Pain

Unmet Stop 1 P1 from #4751 (write-back 5799047264): `verify:ac` safety-rejects `node --test …` because first token `"node"` is not in `ALLOWED_FIRST_TOKENS`, so a standard Node project cannot pass `task deft:check` even when the tests themselves pass.

#4751 yolo leftover-split per #4593 after Dual-stop cap 5 spent and finish not still possible (blocking-count 0 then 1). Pain-audit 5800442997 blocked prefix-allowed `--test-reporter=data:` JavaScript evaluation. Recut 5800470603 absorbed exact built-in reporter names. This issue owns that remainder.

## Why this number exists

Operator confirmed leftover-split. No deliverable remainder stays on #4751 (Dual-stop remaining 0; finish not still possible). This number holds P1 as filed: a closed `node --test` argv grammar in `evaluateCommandSafety`.

mechanism-shaped: true

Refs #4751, #4593.

## Bound remainder (from #4751 recut 5800470603)

- First ship is a closed `node --test` argv grammar inside `evaluateCommandSafety`. Add `node` to the static list and route it through that grammar, same as python. Fall-through `{ ok: true, reason: null }` for `node` is forbidden. Do not ship a register-test-runner recipe as this remainder.
- After `node`, `tokens[0]` is exactly `--test`. Every later token that starts with `-` must start with `--test-` or `--experimental-test-`. Refuse `--test-reporter-destination` and `--test-rerun-failures` including `=value`. `--test-reporter` / `--test-reporter=` values are exact built-in names (`spec`, `tap`, `junit`, `lcov`, `dot`) via in-tree exact-token match. Refuse `data:`, path-like, and package-name reporter values. Non-dash positionals pass. Coverage flags only after `--test`; coverage-first stays refused. Do not copy `tool-events/classify.ts` `some(--test)`. Keep `-r` / `-e` / `-p` on the negative list.
- Negative cases: `--import=`, `--require=`, `--experimental-loader=`, `--loader=`, `--inspect=`, `--inspect-port=`, `--eval=`, `--test-reporter-destination=`, `--test-rerun-failures=`, `--test-reporter=data:`, `--test-reporter=./file`, plus space forms of `--import` / `--require` / `--watch` / `--inspect-brk`, plus `-r` / `-e` / `-p`.
- Persist recovery: a stored `literal_acceptance_rejected` row for a command that now passes current safety must be reconciled; admission of a new grammar does not leave the old first-token refuse blocking. Do not clear the whole ledger.
- Refusal reason for an unknown first token enumerates the accepted first tokens. The `safety-rejected` remedy names `npm test` / `pnpm test` as the known-safe wrap. That wrap is a different recorded command; it does not make the original `node --test` string admissible.
- Scope sentence: this remainder changes the first-token grammar only. It does not change which fields are AC oracles. FiScope `npm run lint` / `npm run build` / `task deft:check` stays a different first-token family (#4751 comment 5737701588).
- Flip the `safety-branches.test.ts` pins that refuse `node --test` with the grammar. `run.ts` `shell: true` / `env: process.env` stays the #4702 residual.

## What this is not

- Not adding bare `node` to the first-token allowlist.
- Not a register-test-runner recipe.
- Not wrapping the filed command as `npm test` / `pnpm test` (those are a different recorded command).
- Not FiScope `npm run lint` / `npm run build` / `task deft:check` (comment 5737701588).
- Not changing which fields are AC oracles.
